tour.title: Welcome to ConductLoop — Quick Day-1 Wins
tour.tagline: An AI team on your own machine, run with your own key.
tour.step1_desc: ConductLoop uses your own provider key (BYOK). It is stored in your system keychain, or in an encrypted local vault if there is no keychain. Without a key the app still opens; agents just cannot answer yet.
tour.step1_done: ✓ Done — your key stays on this machine
tour.step2_desc: Your workspace is a small team of AI agents led by a CEO agent. Give the CEO a goal; it plans the work, hands tasks to the other agents and reports back for your approval.
tour.step2_done: ✓ Done — the CEO is waiting for a goal
tour.step3_desc: Notes are plain Markdown files on your disk. Your agents can read them for context, and you can use the AI actions in the sidebar on any note.
tour.step3_done: ✓ Done — your notes never leave this machine unless you send them
tour.step4_desc: Connectors let your agents read from and act on the services you choose, such as RSS feeds or any MCP server. Nothing is connected until you turn it on, and actions that change something ask you first.
tour.step4_done: ✓ Done — connect more whenever you need them
tour.step5_desc: That's the quick tour: your own key, a team led by a CEO, local notes and the connectors you pick.
tour.final_desc: Give your CEO a first goal and see how the team splits the work.
